newsitem.title: UK: NatWest details project finance hires.
newsitem.headline: NatWest details project finance hires.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank Plc, on Wednesday announced the appointment of three senior staff to its global project and trade finance group.
NatWest said in a statement it had hired Geert Jan Leest from MeesPierson to head its trade receiveables team in London.
The group has also appointed William Pavone as director of specialised finance in Milan.
Pavone, who will have responsibility for international and domestic project and structured trade finance, was previously head of BZW's structured finance division.
NatWest said Odile Etienne, who worked with Pavone at BZW, was also joining his team.
It has also hired Robert Wallin, from Skanska AB. Wallin will be based in London and have special responsibility for Scandinavian exporters and telecommunications projects globally.
